messages.title: Gemma 4 support is here in 1.9.103 🚀
messages.message:
Shots Studio now supports Gemma 4 `.litertlm` models for on-device AI.

What's new:
• Download the recommended Gemma 4 E2B model directly from AI Settings
• Sideload `.litertlm`, `.task`, and `.bin` models manually
• Keep screenshot analysis fully on-device with lower storage needs than the previous recommended model

With love,
Team Shots Studio
